snapshot.label: Snapshot 004
snapshot.scope: Kempsey Shire Council terminology encountered in Council webpages, planning material, policies, meeting records, contribution registers, procurement material and related NSW statutory terminology.
snapshot.method: Terms are preserved as encountered. Expansions are recorded only where supported. Unresolved codes remain unresolved rather than being guessed.
snapshot.status: Cumulative through Sweep 004. Snapshots 001, 002 and 003 remain frozen and are not overwritten. Further research passes will continue as separately numbered DOCX snapshots.

classificationRules.meaning: Appears in historical KSC material but has been superseded, renamed or replaced.
NSW Government, Commonwealth or industry terminology used by KSC.
Code or abbreviation is demonstrably used, but its literal expansion has not yet been established from an authoritative source.
Meaning depends on context and requires disambiguation.

items: Expanded current KSC policy-control architecture using the Policy Framework Policy and current procedure documents.
Added current procurement shorthand and platform terminology from KSC tender/procurement material.
Added corporate and financial terminology evidenced in KSC planning and Long-Term Financial Plan material.
Added engineering and standards shorthand encountered in KSC planning and procurement sources.
Confirmed TQE remains a current KSC procurement identifier family; its literal expansion remains unresolved.
Recorded KSC policy Document Number examples without inferring the meaning of their prefixes.
Incorporated the A-to-G block of the official Kempsey Development Control Plan 2026 Appendix 1, Table E.1 abbreviation/acronym glossary.
Flagged two material KSC terminology collisions: CMP = Coastal Management Program or Conservation Management Plan depending on context; BCA and BCA 2016 refer to different instruments.
Added meeting-record shorthand and identifier syntax including Cr, Clr, KDCP, FNA, ERSA, Council File Number family FYY/####[/##], and resolution identifiers YYYY.NN(N).
Added further legacy CPOL and procedure identifiers cited in the 2013 DCP, without treating historical references as proof of current policy status.
Reclassified F22/1933 as part of an evidenced KSC F-year File/Document Number family while leaving the literal meaning of the leading F unresolved.

DCP Appendix 1 terminology was checked against KSC’s current DCP page and an indexed HTML rendering of Part E. The KSC Part E PDF endpoint could not be fetched by the research environment, so that access limitation is recorded rather than concealed.

Added KSC water and sewer management terminology from the Water Supply Asset Management Plan, Drinking Water Management System material, current water-service pages and the Water and Sewer Equivalent Tenement Determination Procedure.
Added current development-processing shorthand and identifiers including REFDA, RFI and s4.55(2) modification notation.
Added current corporate action-code families from the Delivery Program 2025-2029 and Operational Plan architecture: EN.DP#, EC.DP#, CO.DP#, LE.DP# and the corresponding OP-code families.
Added governance and emergency-management shorthand including ELT, LEMC and HM CRG, where KSC sources support the expansion.

Expanded the register with legacy asset-management abbreviations that remain useful when reading older KSC infrastructure records, while marking them LEGACY rather than silently treating them as current.
TQE, T6, LD and the leading F in F-year file numbers remain unresolved; no unsupported expansions were introduced.

KSC PDF screenshots were attempted for key water-management documents during source verification but the web cache could not return the raster pages. Extracted indexed text and current KSC webpages were retained as the evidentiary basis, and the access limitation is recorded rather than concealed.

referenceSections.title: Corporate performance action-code architecture — Sweep 004
items: Current Delivery Program 2025-2029 families: EN.DP# = Environment; EC.DP# = Economy; CO.DP# = Community; LE.DP# = Leadership.
Operational Plan actions use corresponding OP families: EN.OP#, EC.OP#, CO.OP# and LE.OP#.
The number identifies the individual action within the thematic family. These codes are evidence-traceable identifiers and should be preserved verbatim in extracts and investigation registers.
Operational-plan code sets are annual implementation codes beneath the four-year Delivery Program; an OP code therefore must be read with the applicable financial-year Operational Plan.

referenceSections.title: Development processing identifiers — Sweep 004
items: REFDA###### is the initial reference identifier used by KSC after submission through the NSW Planning Portal, before the application completes intake processing.
DA######## is the later development-application identifier family already recorded in this glossary.
RFI is a process status/document shorthand, not an application-number family.
s4.55(2) identifies a statutory modification pathway and can appear beside an existing DA number and revision suffix.

referenceSections.title: Identifier architecture observed
items: YYYY/LD-##### — Former development-record identifier family. Literal internal meaning of LD remains unresolved.
T6-YY-### — Separate legacy KSC development/application identifier family. Literal meaning of T6 remains unresolved.
DA######## — Newer development-application identifier architecture used by Council.
PP-YYYY-#### — Planning Proposal identifier architecture.
MP##_#### — NSW Major Project identifier architecture rather than an ordinary KSC DA identifier.
TQE##/## or TQE##-## — Tender/procurement reference architecture. Literal expansion of TQE remains unresolved.
REV / REV01 / REV02 ... — Revision suffix architecture.
Meeting item 11.4 / 11.4.1 etc. — Hierarchical agenda and attachment numbering used in Council meeting packages.

referenceSections.title: Current policy document-control architecture — cumulative through Sweep 003
items: Current KSC policies use structured Document Control fields including Title, Policy Number, Version, Document Number, Audience, Policy Type, Category, Subcategory, approval/effective/review dates, Responsible Officer, Approval Body, consultation requirements and Version Control.
Observed current policy identifiers include Policy 5.11 / Version 4 / Document Number D24/73553 and Policy 5.9 / Version 5 / Document Number F22/1933.

KSC formally distinguishes Council Policies from Operational Policies. Council Policies have an external focus and are adopted or revised by the governing body; Operational Policies have an internal focus and are adopted or revised by the General Manager or delegate.
Procedures use hierarchical identifiers under a parent policy, evidenced by Procedure 2.1.4 under Policy 2.1 and Procedure 5.1.3 under Policy 5.1.
The literal meanings of the D24 and F22 Document Number prefixes have not been established. No prefix expansion is inferred.

referenceSections.title: Collision recap (terms already detailed above, flagged again for visibility)
items: CMP — KSC uses CMP for both Coastal Management Program and Conservation Management Plan. Never expand CMP without identifying the source context.
BCA / BCA 2016 — In the KSC DCP glossary, BCA means Building Code of Australia, while "BCA 2016" means Biodiversity Conservation Act 2016. The year qualifier is therefore material, not cosmetic.
Cr / Clr — Current KSC meeting material uses both Cr and Clr as councillor-title abbreviations. Treat them as observed title variants, not different roles.

FYY/#### — KSC File Numbers use F-prefixed year-like syntax, but the leading F has not been authoritatively expanded. Do not silently rewrite F as "File" even though the value sits in a field labelled File Number.

items.description: EPA may mean NSW Environment Protection Authority, while historical KSC planning material can use EPA Act for the Environmental Planning and Assessment Act 1979. Never conflate the two.
Historical environmental-zone references can be obsolete under the later C1-C4 conservation-zone nomenclature. Date-control is required.
Historical contribution terminology corresponds to current sections 7.11 / 7.12 respectively.
The date matters. Kempsey DCP 2013 and Kempsey DCP 2026 must not be treated as interchangeable.
In corporate planning, OP means Operational Plan. Elsewhere KSC uses the phrase Operational Policy as a policy classification. Do not assume the two are interchangeable.
KSC material contains both IWCM (Integrated Water Cycle Management) and the older IWCMS (Integrated Water Cycle Management Strategy). Preserve the form actually used by the source and date it.
